articles.summary: Each season in New England brings with it a unique set of challenges when it comes to the comfort and energy efficiency of your home. While it’s important to stay on top of seasonal changes, like sealing drafty windows with heat-shrink plastic, there are ways to save money year round by weatherproofing – regardless of the current season. We’ve rounded up 10 of the best tips to start you on your way.
articles.title: Weatherproofing for Any Season

articles.summary: Wildlife and electrical infrastructure share the same space, and that relationship has an impact on electric reliability. Animals can cause outages by chewing on lines, building nests on equipment, or creating unintended electrical paths. At Unitil, wildlife is responsible for roughly 13%* of power outages across our service territory, making it a common cause of service interruptions. Most animal-related outages occur in the spring and the fall when animals are most active.
articles.title: How Animals Impact Our Electrical Infrastructure
